facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Arts in sociology at Fictional Riverquartz University in 2016.
facts.zh: 2016 年在虚构河石英大学获得社会学文学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid customer research assistant at Fictional Hazelmarket Research from 2016-09 to 2021-03.
facts.zh: 2016-09 至 2021-03 在虚构榛市研究公司任有薪客户研究助理。

facts.en: At that employer, cleaned survey exports and summarized open comments using a supervisor-approved coding guide.
facts.zh: 在该雇主处，清理问卷导出数据，并使用主管批准的编码指南汇总开放式评论。

facts.en: Completed a part-time postgraduate certificate in urban studies at Fictional Stonebay College in 2022-12.
facts.zh: 2022-12 在虚构石湾学院完成非全日制城市研究研究生证书课程。

facts.en: Paid planning research assistant at Fictional Willowdistrict Studio from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构柳区工作室任有薪规划研究助理。

facts.en: Compiles public consultation responses into thematic summaries and keeps a traceable link to each response.
facts.zh: 将公众咨询意见编成主题摘要，并保留与每条意见的可追溯关联。

facts.en: Builds descriptive tables in R and explains missing-response counts in accompanying notes.
facts.zh: 使用 R 建立描述性统计表，并在随附备注中解释缺失回答数量。

facts.en: A senior planner chooses policy recommendations and signs reports submitted to clients.
facts.zh: 高级规划师选择政策建议，并签署提交客户的报告。

facts.en: Contributed to a 2025-10 neighbourhood consultation analysis with 260 submitted forms.
facts.zh: 参与 2025-10 社区咨询分析，共有 260 份提交表单。

facts.en: Of those forms, 198 answered the transport question and 62 left it blank.
facts.zh: 其中 198 份回答交通问题，62 份留空。

facts.en: Among the 198 answers, 121 selected improved bus frequency; these results describe the consultation responses, not the views of every neighbourhood resident.
facts.zh: 在 198 份回答中，121 份选择提高公交班次频率；这些结果描述的是咨询答复，而非全体社区居民的意见。

facts.en: Personally wrote the response-cleaning script and drafted the transport summary; a colleague analyzed housing comments.
facts.zh: 个人编写意见数据清理脚本并起草交通摘要；一名同事分析住房评论。

facts.en: Uses R, spreadsheets and simple QGIS layer viewing for research support.
facts.zh: 使用 R、电子表格及简单 QGIS 图层查看来支持研究。

facts.en: For the urban studies course, prepared a small-area walking-route comparison from supplied classroom data.
facts.zh: 在城市研究课程中，依据提供的课堂数据编制小区域步行路线比较。

facts.en: That assignment was an academic exercise and did not form part of a statutory planning application.
facts.zh: 该作业为学术练习，未构成法定规划申请的一部分。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Pebblebench Neighbours from 2020-05 to 2022-09, distributing event notices.
facts.zh: 2020-05 至 2022-09 在虚构卵石凳邻里团体做志愿者，派发活动通知。

facts.en: Co-created a noncommercial neighbourhood-history quiz with 2 volunteers in 2024; personally wrote clue text.
facts.zh: 2024 年与 2 名志愿者共同创作非商业社区历史问答；个人撰写线索文字。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching imaginary street layouts and collecting patterns for mosaic coasters.
facts.zh: 爱好素描想象中的街道布局，以及收集马赛克杯垫图案。

facts.en: Presents draft descriptive findings at internal meetings and records reviewers’ requested corrections.
facts.zh: 在内部会议中展示描述性分析结果草稿，并记录审核人员要求的修正。

facts.en: No professional planning registration or independent statutory submission responsibility is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录专业规划注册资格或独立负责法定申报的职责。
